svg.text: Every failure class has a named recovery
RECOVERY_ACTIONS in gateway/src/gateway/fallback.mjs, then a user-facing fallback in every bot.
GATEWAY SIDE · 11 error classes → 6 recovery actions
slot backs off base · 2^(n-1) ±10% jitter, chain continues
credential disabled for the whole process lifetime
min-context raised, candidates too small are dropped
that model benched 5 minutes, next candidate answers
retired model id benched 24h, credential stays healthy
whole provider benched, strike counter increments
same treatment as a 5xx: provider-level bench
transport failure is provider-level, not request-level
blank completion is an error, never returned to the user
malformed request — retrying would only burn quota
unclassified upstream failure walks to the next candidate
BOT SIDE · tests/test_degradation.py — 5 bots × 5 gateway failures = 25 scenarios
Pass condition: a reply reaches the user, the handler does not raise, and no traceback, URL or provider name leaks into the message.
